user.title: Add a sourdough starter
user.description: Track when this starter was fed and when it is due again.

data_description.last_fed: Optional. Leave empty if the starter has not been fed yet.
data_description.bench_interval_hours: Hours between feeds while stored on the bench. Default: 48.
data_description.fridge_interval_hours: Hours between feeds while refrigerated. Default: 168.
data_description.preferred_time_enabled: Align interval-based deadlines to a consistent local clock time.
data_description.bench_preferred_feed_time: The local clock time used for bench deadlines.
data_description.fridge_preferred_feed_time: The local clock time used for refrigerated deadlines.
data_description.holiday_mode_entity: Scheduled reminders pause while this existing binary sensor is on.
data_description.due_soon_hours: How many hours before the deadline the first reminder is sent. Use 0 to disable the early reminder.
data_description.notification_targets: Choose one or more notification entities.
data_description.quiet_hours_enabled: Suppress scheduled reminders during the configured overnight period.
data_description.quiet_start: No scheduled reminders are sent from this time.
data_description.quiet_end: Scheduled reminders resume at this time.
data_description.confirm_feed: Send a confirmation to the same targets whenever a feed is recorded.
data_description.audio_enabled: Speak feeding reminders through Home Assistant media players.
data_description.audio_tts_entity: Select the voice or text-to-speech provider used for announcements.
data_description.audio_targets: Select one or more media players. Unavailable players are skipped.
data_description.audio_lead_time_hours: Hours before feeding is due to begin spoken reminders. Use 0 to begin when overdue.
data_description.audio_interval_minutes: Minutes between spoken reminders. Audio also respects quiet hours and snooze.
data_description.audio_volume_percent: Temporary volume used for spoken reminders. The previous player volume is restored after the announcement.
data_description.light_targets: Select colour-capable lights to flash three times whenever a push or audio feeding reminder is sent.
data_description.light_color: Choose the reminder flash colour. The default is red.
data_description.light_flash_count: Number of colour pulses in each light reminder. Default: 3.
data_description.light_pulse_seconds: Seconds the reminder colour remains visible for each pulse. Default: 1.
data_description.light_gap_seconds: Seconds spent at the original colour or off between pulses. Default: 0.25.
